context: A mom and son chat at breakfast
purpose: Teach: トースト/キャンドル/めんどくさい/しわ/拾う/ガラガラ/バンバン/ローマ字

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、朝ごはん、本気で、絶対、トースト、絶対、焼いたよ
lines.en: Sho, I seriously made you toast for breakfast this morning.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact opening. Slight emphasis on 'made' — a small pride in the effort. Casual, practical tone. The voice of someone stating what's done and moving forward.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、キャンドル、絶対、お父さん、絶対、誕生日に、絶対、買ったよね
lines.en: Mom, Dad really did buy me that candle for my birthday, didn't he?
lines.style: Eager, searching confirmation. Quick pace, slight upward lilt at the end. The voice of a child who wants reassurance that something real happened, testing his memory against hers.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 宿題、本気で、絶対、めんどくさい、絶対、と、絶対、思っていても、絶対、頑張ろうね、翔くん
lines.en: Even when homework feels annoying, let's keep trying our best, okay Sho?
lines.style: Steady, gentle persuasion. Warm but purposeful — not lecturing, inviting. Slow enough to land each phrase. The voice of someone who knows he can hear her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、おでこに、絶対、しわ、絶対、増えたよね、ママ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa really has gotten more wrinkles on his forehead, hasn't he?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation delivered as fact, not question. Quiet precision in his voice — the startled noticing of a child who sees what adults miss. No judgment, just honest.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 公園で、本気で、絶対、ゴミ、絶対、拾うこと、絶対、続けようね、翔くん
lines.en: Let's keep picking up trash at the park, okay Sho? It's important.
lines.style: Tender but clear direction. Slow, deliberate opening. Warm undertone without softness — this matters and she knows he can do it. Eye contact level steady.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おもちゃの、本気で、絶対、ガラガラ、絶対、まだ、絶対、置いてあるよ、ママ
lines.en: Look, Sho — your toy rattle is still there where you left it.
lines.style: Warm, animated noticing. Quick, bright pace. The voice of someone pointing something out to a child with genuine interest — 'Look!' energy, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 雨が、本気で、絶対、バンバン、絶対、降ってきたわよ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, the rain's really coming down hard now.
lines.style: Alert but calm observation. Quick opening on the first phrase. Slight edge of attention — she's noticed something and is letting him know. Practical, not alarmed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、ローマ字、絶対、書けるようになったよ、ママ
lines.en: Mom, I can really write romaji now!
lines.style: Proud, bright delivery. Quick, energized pace. The full reach of a child's joy in his own accomplishment — wanting her to see it. Small laugh-breath underneath.
